nodes.label: Start
nodes.description: Every change begins from a known, working system generation

nodes.label: Edit config files
nodes.description: Configuration changes define the desired system state

nodes.label: Stage changes
nodes.description: Only git-tracked files are visible to the nix flake

nodes.label: Run rebuild
nodes.description: Evaluates staged config and builds the new generation

nodes.label: Build succeeds?
nodes.description: A failed build never activates, so the running system stays safe

nodes.label: Done
nodes.description: The new generation is active and can be rolled back if needed

nodes.label: Review error log
nodes.description: The last 'error:' line usually points to the root cause

nodes.label: Fix config
nodes.description: Errors prevent activation; must be corrected before retrying
